entries.why: the tick divider per BEAT, 06 03 08 04 followed by four zeros and a pointer table; the four sequencer places load it (0xC0054360 and three more), read in both
cmp r1, #3 behind the BEAT getter (0xC0044478, ldrb r0, [r0, #0x2a]) in the value change of the page BEAT, the setter 0xC00445F8 follows; read in both, same sequence
movge r1, #3 right after the clamp's cmp, read in both
ldr r1, = "?" (0xC00908DD) behind the jump table that loads \16, \32, \\8 Tri, \16 Tri for the page BEAT; read in both
mov r2, sp right behind the text loads of the page BEAT, r1 holds the text; read in both
the export length of a part (push, ldr sb, bl pattern, bl BEAT getter, BEAT - 1 against the two tables); read in both, same sequence
the tick divider the sequencer took at PLAY: the four places that load the divider table store it here (0xC0054368 on the synth)
cmp r3, #2 on BEAT - 1 in the export length (48 kHz samples) per part, the function the 16 part loop of the export calls; read in both, same sequence
ldrls r2, = steps per quarter (08 03 06) after that cmp
ldrls r2, = steps per bar (10 0C 0C) after that cmp
cmp r3, #2 on the cached BEAT - 1 ([r6, #0x10]) in the second export length, read in both, same sequence
ldrls r2, = steps per quarter after that cmp
ldrls r2, = steps per bar after that cmp
cmp r3, #2 on BEAT - 1 read from a pattern block (+0x26) in the third export length, read in both, same sequence
ldrls r2, = steps per quarter after that cmp
ldrls r2, = steps per bar after that cmp
cmp r3, #2 on BEAT - 1 read from a pattern block (+0x26) in the fourth export length, read in both, same sequence
ldrls r2, = steps per quarter after that cmp
ldrls r2, = steps per bar after that cmp
